title: Specializing Large Language Models to Simulate Survey Response Distributions for Global Populations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-predicted probability distributions for multiple-choice survey responses, conditioned on specific countries, against actual human response distributions from the World Values Survey and Pew Global Attitudes Survey using Jensen-Shannon Divergence (1-JSD) and Earth Mover Distance (EMD).

Re-evaluating the fine-tuned models on the survey datasets with shuffled multiple-choice answer options to measure the 'A-bias' effect (the tendency of models to disproportionately select the first choice).
